Commentary of al-Baghawi (Ma'alim al-Tanzil) on surah 103, verses 1–3:

Surat al-'Asr is Meccan. [[Ibn Mardawayh narrated from Ibn 'Abbas, who said: "Surat (Wal-'Asr) was revealed in Mecca." See: al-Durr al-Manthur: 8/621.]]

In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

* *

﴿By time (al-'asr)﴾. Ibn 'Abbas said: "By the age (al-dahr)." It has been said: He swore by it because in it there is a lesson for the one who reflects. It has also been said: the meaning is "by the Lord of the time (wa-Rabb al-'asr)," and likewise in similar instances. Ibn Kaysan said: By al-'asr he meant the night and the day, and the two are called "the two 'asrs." Al-Hasan said: It is the period from the decline of the sun until its setting. [[See: 'Abd al-Razzaq in al-Tafsir: 2/394; Fath al-Bari: 8/729.]] Qatadah said: It is the last hour of the hours of the day. [[Narrated by 'Abd al-Razzaq in al-Tafsir: 2/394, without the word "last."]] Muqatil said: He swore by the afternoon prayer (salat al-'asr), which is the middle prayer (al-salat al-wusta).

﴿Indeed, mankind is in loss﴾, that is, in ruin and deficiency. It has been said: By "mankind" he meant [[al-kafir]] [[In manuscript "b": al-kafir (the disbeliever).]], as evidenced by his exception of the believers. "Loss" (al-khusr) is the forfeiting of a person's capital through the destruction of his own self and his lifespan [[through sins]] [[Addition from manuscript "b".]], and these two are the greatest of his capital.

﴿Except those who believe and do righteous deeds﴾: indeed, they are not in loss. ﴿And advise one another﴾: some of them enjoined others. ﴿To truth﴾: to the Qur'an, as said by al-Hasan and Qatadah. Muqatil said: to faith and monotheism.

﴿And advise one another to patience﴾ in fulfilling the obligations and upholding the command of Allah. Ibn 'Awn narrated from Ibrahim, who said: He meant that when a person is granted a long life in this world and grows old, he is in decline and regression, except for the believers, for their rewards are recorded for them, along with the good deeds they used to do in their youth and health. This is like His saying: ﴿Certainly We created man in the best of stature; then We reduced him to the lowest of the low, except those who believe and do righteous deeds﴾.
